summary: A council member explains a no vote by naming the specific lines and positions they would not fund, after a short nod to the work that went into the budget.
realLife: Council members in Newport, Los Angeles and Portland each gave reasons for voting no. They began with respect for the process or the staff, then went item by item: new departments and jobs, street repair against social programs, public safety cuts. One put the question to residents as a question; one said what would have turned the vote to yes.
sources: David Carlin, Newport RI councilor, statement on his no vote on the budget, Jun 12, 2024: https://thenewportbuzz.com/?p=49517
